sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Coding-agent ergonomics and harnesses lead the list; agent-native creative and engineering tools extend into diagrams, images, architecture, and CAD; multi-agent systems appear in finance and practical AI engineering. Python is the most common language among listed entries, followed by TypeScript and JavaScript.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The snapshot is centered less on model releases and more on the operating layer around agents: skills, harnesses, UX conventions, local runtimes, and domain-specific interfaces.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: GitHub's strongest daily signal is the maturation of coding agents into a broader software and knowledge-work platform. Reusable skills, development methods, local runtimes, and vertical tools are attracting attention alongside core AI infrastructure.
